case.title: The Missing Heirloom
case.introduction: A storm rages outside. The guests gather in the dining hall.
case.crime: A priceless necklace is gone. It was on the table at 8:10 PM.
case.escape_plan: The target will slip out through the back garden after the storm.

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.description: Large room with a long table.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: Wet grass and a hidden gate.

characters.name: Evelyn Hart
characters.secret: She once stole a small painting years ago.
characters.goal: Find the necklace for the owner
characters.alibi: She was in the library reading

characters.name: Victor Lane
characters.secret: He lost a lot of money in a bad investment.
characters.goal: Get a good deal on the necklace
characters.alibi: He was in the garden looking at the storm
lies: He says he was in the dining hall

characters.name: Samira Khan
characters.secret: Has a hidden stash of spices she sells
characters.goal: Earn a tip from the guests

characters.name: Detective Lucas Reed
characters.background: Called for a private security check
characters.secret: He once let a suspect go for a bribe
characters.alibi: He was in the dining hall watching everyone

characters.name: Mara Whitfield
characters.background: Invited as a friend of the host
characters.secret: She is really Lila Marquez, a former jewel thief
characters.alibi: She was in the garden looking at the storm
lies: She claims she never met the host before

evidence.name: Glove with torn fabric
evidence.description: A silk glove with a small tear that matches Mara's dress

evidence.name: Lockpick
evidence.description: A metal pick found near the garden gate

evidence.name: Host diary entry
evidence.description: Notes about a past meeting with Lila Marquez

evidence.name: Broken vase
evidence.description: A vase broken near the table with Victor's fingerprint

hidden_clues: The storm knocked out the lights at 8:15 PM
The back garden door was unlocked
red_herrings: The cufflink was found near the necklace

solution.reasoning: The glove matches her dress. The lockpick shows she can open the gate. The diary links her past as Lila. These are key evidence. The vase fingerprint is a fake clue.

state.current_objective: Find out which guest is not who they say they are.
